How we work

Four rules we do not break.

RULE 01

Evidence or it stays off the page

A claim goes into a listing only if the client can show it. Every score in an audit carries a quoted sentence from the listing.

RULE 02

Public data only

The benchmark uses the public AWS Marketplace Discovery API. We never ask for access to a seller's portal for an audit.

RULE 03

Aggregates, not call-outs

We publish counts and patterns. We do not publish any single listing's score, and a client's score never appears in anything public.

RULE 04

Independent

Nimbuy is not affiliated with AWS. The score is our own audit of the listing text, not an AWS rating.
